newsitem.title: USA: NCR sees improvement in full-yr '97 results.
newsitem.headline: NCR sees improvement in full-yr '97 results.

text.p: NCR Corp, the computer company spun off from AT&T Corp last year, said Wednesday it remains optimistic it can show earnings and revenue growth for the full-year 1997.

Lars Nyberg, NCR chairman and chief executive officer, said it expects the growth to affect orders and revenue in the company's core businesses as well as improvements in net income and per-share results.
Nyberg made the forecast as NCR reported a smaller second-quarter loss of $4.0 million or $0.04 per share, against a loss of $18 million or $0.18 per share a year ago.
Revenue in the latest quarter was $1.645 billion, 2.0 percent lower than the $1.679 billion a year ago.

Worldwide revenue was up 1.0 percent on a local currency basis, but down two percent on a reported dollar basis. Low single-digit order gains were posted in the Americas and Europe/Middle East/Africa regions, it said.

"Our retail and financial businesses reported sizable improvement, and expenses remained under control during the quarter as we continued to make investments in research and development and sales training " Nyberg said.
"We are pleased with our progress, but not with our pace," he added, noting there were "challenges" in achieving the company's goals.
